Calm waters are surrounded by dense tropical rainforest. The lake scenery differs from the broad channels of the rivers and offers a chance to observe nature by boat, far from the bustle of the city.

A trip to the lake combines a journey on the water with an exploration of the surrounding forest. Visitors look for birds and other Amazonian wildlife; travel itineraries also mention the possibility of seeing giant river otters. Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed, and the pace of the excursion depends on conditions on the water and the recommendations of the local guide.

In Trindade, walks along the beaches lead into forest trails. At Praia do Meio, the path begins toward Praia do Caixa d'Aço and a natural pool where seawater is surrounded by large rocks.

In the village, visitors can stop at Praia dos Ranchos, with its bars and restaurants. The coastal part of Serra da Bocaina National Park preserves the meeting of the sea, forest and small rivers.

## Trinidad — Cuba's most beautiful city!

Trinidad, situated near the Caribbean Sea in Sancti Spíritus Province, was founded in 1514 by the Spanish conquistador Diego Velázquez Consuelo de Cuéllar.

Its extensive Old Town, admired for its fine colonial architecture, was recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. Visiting Trinidad feels like traveling back in time: it is one of the best-preserved colonial cities in the Americas and is rightly regarded as Cuba's most beautiful city.

## Trinidad — an open-air museum!

Trinidad is something of an open-air museum, with cobbled streets and colonial-style houses. The city itself has been declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. It is also a city of museums, including the Historical Museum, Archaeological Museum and even a Romantic Museum. Extensive sugar plantations lie in the San Luis Valley near Trinidad. In the surrounding area are the ruins of a nineteenth-century sugar factory, where enormous cauldrons can still be seen.

### Trujillo — a resort city in Peru!

Trujillo is known as the city of "eternal" spring. Its climate attracted wealthy residents, who left behind beautiful examples of colonial architecture.

## Holidays in Trujillo

### Trujillo — an ideal resort destination for travelers!

Chan Chan was the largest adobe city of a pre-Inca civilization in South America. The world-famous Temple of the Dragon is also here, along with the Temples of the Sun and Moon. Huanchaco Bay is known for its ideal surfing conditions, and those interested can also enjoy a ride on picturesque reed boats.
